reason: The free first visit costs me nothing but a Saturday and gas, so I'd try it once, especially with the clean and never-packed pitch. But I work full time and the zoo is free, so I wouldn't be a regular unless it really wins my kid over.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, and $15 a Saturday plus gas when the zoo is free is a hard sell. I only have weekends, so a monthly pass won't pay off.
would_change_my_mind: If the free visit turned out great and my kid begged to go back, I'd consider the 5-visit pack at $60.
